messages.content:
You revise a project plan after feedback from the person who owns it. Some steps are finished
or running: never remove or change them. Change only the unfinished steps.

Return JSON with:
- remove: ids of unfinished steps that the feedback makes unnecessary or wrong.
- change: unfinished steps to adjust ({"id", and any of "title", "description", "acceptance_criteria"}).
- add: new steps, in the same format as before: key (n1, n2, ...), title, description, phase ("implement" or
  "test"), requirement_ids (only ids from the list), acceptance_criteria, effort_hours, depends_on (keys of other new
  steps, or ids of existing steps), group.
- notes: one sentence on what you changed.

Keep every requirement covered by some step. Do the smallest change that follows the feedback. Never invent
requirements.

Feedback: Don't use threads; use asyncio for all networking.

Requirements:
R1 [must] The server must accept at least 10 clients connected at the same time.
R2 [must] Each client must choose a unique nickname when it connects.
R3 [must] A message sent by one client must be delivered to every other connected client.
R4 [must] The server shall announce when a client joins or leaves the chat.
R5 [should] Clients should be able to send a private message with the command /msg.
R6 [could] The server may keep a history of the last 50 messages for new clients.
R7 [must] The server must not crash when a client disconnects without warning.
R8 [should] Messages should reach other clients within one second on a local network.

Current plan:
research [research, FINISHED/RUNNING - do not touch] Research the approach (requirements: -; after: -)
verify [research, FINISHED/RUNNING - do not touch] Check the research findings (requirements: -; after: research)
design [design, FINISHED/RUNNING - do not touch] Design the solution (requirements: -; after: verify)
T1 [implement, FINISHED/RUNNING - do not touch] Implement server core for TCP connections (requirements: R1; after: design)
T2 [implement, unfinished] Add unique nickname registration (requirements: R2; after: T1)
T6 [implement, unfinished] Handle abrupt client disconnects gracefully (requirements: R7; after: T1)
T7 [test, unfinished] Test server capacity and stability (requirements: R1; after: T1)
T3 [implement, unfinished] Implement broadcast and join/leave announcements (requirements: R3, R4; after: T2)
T12 [test, unfinished] Test robustness on abrupt disconnects (requirements: R7; after: T6)
T8 [test, unfinished] Test nickname uniqueness enforcement (requirements: R2; after: T2)
T4 [implement, unfinished] Add private messaging command (requirements: R5; after: T3)
T9 [test, unfinished] Test broadcast and join/leave announcements (requirements: R3, R4; after: T3)
T5 [implement, unfinished] Store last 50 messages for history (requirements: R6; after: T3)
T13 [test, unfinished] Measure message latency under one second (requirements: R8; after: T4, T5, T6)
T10 [test, unfinished] Test private messaging functionality (requirements: R5; after: T4)
T11 [test, unfinished] Test message history delivery (requirements: R6; after: T5)
T14 [document, unfinished] Prepare README (requirements: -; after: T7, T8, T9, T10, T11, T12, T13)
T15 [document, unfinished] Prepare Design and test report (requirements: -; after: T7, T8, T9, T10, T11, T12, T13)
review [review, unfinished] Final review (requirements: -; after: T14, T15)
